podcast.description: 每天自动更新的 Bloomberg 公开 RSS 中文摘要，适合 iPhone 和 CarPlay 播放。

episodes.title: 每日财经简报
episodes.summary: 今日聚焦全球金融市场动态，涵盖货币政策、汇率变动及能源市场等重要话题。

sources.title: Czech Rates to Stay Put as Policymakers Lean on Inflation Buffer
sources.description: Czech policymakers are poised to keep interest rates on hold as inflation running below target provides a cushion against the immediate impact of surging oil costs.

sources.title: India's Central Bank Ramps Up Key Tool to Defend Falling Rupee
sources.description: India ramped up use of a key tool for defending the rupee to record levels as the currency weakened to an all-time low against the dollar, according to people familiar with the matter.

sources.title: Oil Surges as Energy Assets Hit in Mideast; Fed Holds Rates | The Asia Trade 3/19/2026
sources.description: "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade" brings you everything you need to know to get ahead as the trading day begins in Asia. Bloomberg TV is live from Tokyo and Sydney with Shery Ahn and Haidi Stroud-Watts, getting insight and analysis from newsmakers and industry leaders on the biggest stories shaping global markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: LINE MAN Wongnai To Fund New Acquisitions With IPO
sources.description: LINE MAN Wongnai CEO Yod Chinsupakul says his Thai tech start-up, which connects customers and suppliers through food delivery, groceries and ride-hailing, hopes to fund new acquisitions with its initial public offering. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: Emerging Assets Fall for First Time This Week as Oil Prices Jump
sources.description: Emerging market equities and currencies fell for the first time this week as oil prices surged after attacks on some of the Middle East’s most important energy facilities.

sources.title: Nomura's Willcox: BoJ More Likely To Hike in April
sources.description: Nomura Head of Wholesale and Chairman of Investment Management Christopher Willcox believes the Bank of Japan is more likely to hike rates in April. He speaks with Haslinda Amin on "Insight with Haslinda Amin." (Source: Bloomberg)

sources.title: Powell Digs In as War Forces a New Path for the Fed
sources.description: The embattled chairman raises the stakes against prosecution.

sources.title: Bank of Japan Decision Puts Yen-160 Watch in Focus, Analysts Say
sources.description: The Bank of Japan’s widely expected decision to hold its benchmark rate amid risks from the Iran war left the yen little changed, though analysts said Governor Kazuo Ueda’s remarks later would be key to whether the currency would swing past 160.

digest.episode_summary: 今日聚焦全球金融市场动态，涵盖货币政策、汇率变动及能源市场等重要话题。
digest.lead: 今日的全球经济新闻中，我们关注了多个关键领域的发展。

stories.headline: Czech央行维持利率不变
stories.summary: 由于通胀低于目标水平，捷克央行决定保持利率不变，以应对油价上涨带来的影响。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了全球经济对能源价格波动的敏感性。

stories.headline: 印度央行加大工具使用力度以捍卫贬值的卢比
stories.summary: 为了防止卢比进一步贬值至历史低点，印度央行增加了用于保护本国货币价值的关键工具。
stories.why_it_matters: 这表明了印度政府对汇率稳定的关注。

stories.headline: 油价飙升：中东能源资产受损；美联储维持利率不变
stories.summary: 原油价格因中东地区重要能源设施遭受袭击而上涨，同时美国联邦储备局决定保持利率不变。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了全球市场对能源供应的担忧。

stories.headline: LINE MAN Wongnai计划通过IPO进行新收购
stories.summary: 泰国科技初创公司Wongnai的CEO表示，该公司希望通过首次公开募股来资助新的收购活动。
stories.why_it_matters: 这展示了新兴市场的资本流动和企业扩张策略。

stories.headline: 新兴市场资产本周首次下跌
stories.summary: 由于中东能源设施遭受袭击导致油价上涨，新兴市场股票和货币价格出现下跌。
stories.why_it_matters: 这突显了全球金融市场对地缘政治事件的敏感性。

stories.headline: Nomura认为日本央行更可能在4月加息
stories.summary: Nomura的Christopher Willcox指出，鉴于中东战争的影响，日本央行更有可能在四月份提高利率。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了全球主要央行对地缘政治事件的反应。

stories.headline: Powell面临审判压力下的美联储政策
stories.summary: 尽管面临指控，但美国联邦储备局主席鲍威尔仍坚持其货币政策立场。
stories.why_it_matters: 这体现了高层领导人在面对外部压力时的决策过程。

stories.headline: 日本央行决定维持利率不变
stories.summary: 鉴于中东战争的风险，日本央行决定保持其基准利率不变。
stories.why_it_matters: 这反映了全球主要央行对地缘政治事件的反应。

digest.closing: 以上是今日最重要的财经新闻概览。希望这些信息能帮助您了解全球经济动态。
digest.audio_script: 今天我们关注了几个关键领域的最新发展，首先是捷克央行决定维持利率不变以应对油价上涨的影响。印度央行则加大使用工具来捍卫卢比的汇率。原油价格因中东地区能源设施遭受袭击而飙升，同时美国联邦储备局保持利率不变。泰国科技初创公司Wongnai计划通过首次公开募股进行新收购活动。新兴市场资产本周首次下跌，这反映了地缘政治事件对金融市场的影响。Nomura的Christopher Willcox认为日本央行更可能在四月份加息。尽管面临指控，但美国联邦储备局主席鲍威尔仍坚持其货币政策立场。日本央行决定维持利率不变，鉴于中东战争的风险。希望这些信息能帮助您了解今日最重要的财经新闻概览。
